title: Houston City -Mural Tour & Butterfly Center.
includes: Official City Tour and Butterfly Center admission.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Start your day with a guided tour from our a Cowboy themed center and discover with us Houston's landmarks and history at the Heritage Society's Museum and historic homes.
Experience and explore with us the Historic District, Main Street, Buffalo Bayou, Theatre District, and City Hall.
In addition to a tall Texan skyscraper tour of Downtown Houston aboard our double-decker bus, hop off at the Heritage Society, you will be an urban cowboy when you explore rodeo history and the Texas spirit through the Sam Houston park Collections History Exhibit and with a walking historic houses tour at The Heritage Society, Houston’s history museum complex.
After this, continue to complete your tour to mid-town and back to the original departure point at the Visitors Center.
